svg.aria-label: Where a setting comes from, farthest layer first: your own ~/.crucible/config.json, then the project's .crucible/config.json and .crucible/config.local.json, then the command line, and the nearest layer wins. The two project files may set ordinary settings and tighten permissions, but never loosen permissions, choose a provider, credential or server, or set an environment variable outside crucible's own names; a scalar takes the nearest layer that set it, an object is merged key by key, and most lists add up.
